models.name: Qwen3.8-27B DFlash2 on RTX 3090 (TeksEdge)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B + DFlash2 speculative decoding + context lookup on a single RTX 3090 24GB
models.why: TeksEdge's inference-stack work on one RTX 3090: 82 t/s baseline, 114 with optimized MTP, 138 with DFlash2 + context lookup, 381-382 on a 25K-token document-reproduction workload (16-token verification blocks, ~15 accepted); ordinary chat is about 133 t/s and usable context rose to 138K

engines.quant: DFlash2 speculative decoding + context lookup; ordinary conversation (381-382 t/s only on document reproduction); 138K usable context

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B on DGX Spark (SGLang NVFP4 + DFlash2, long context)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark with SGLang and a 4-bit DFlash2 drafter, 320 to 260K context
models.why: context sweep on one DGX Spark with SGLang, NVFP4 weights, a 4-bit DFlash2 drafter proposing 16 tokens per pass and a BF16 KV cache: 73-74 t/s at 320 to 8K context, 67 at 65K, 56 at 130K, 38 at 260K; repeated prompts cut TTFT from 277 s to 1.2 s via prefix caching

engines.hardware: single NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128GB unified memory)
engines.quant: NVFP4 weights; DFlash2 speculative decoding with 4-bit drafter (16 proposed tokens/pass); BF16 KV cache; thinking off; median of 4 runs; 8K context (67 t/s at 65K, 38 t/s at 260K)
